meta.name: retro
meta.description: Facilitate a structured sprint retrospective — what went well, what didn't, and prioritized action items with owners and deadlines. Use when running a retrospective, reflecting on a sprint, creating action items from team feedback, or learning how to run effective retros.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导团队完成结构化的冲刺回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要带领团队做冲刺回顾并产出可执行的任务
copy.tagline_en: Facilitate a structured sprint retrospective with your team
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run a sprint retrospective and generate actionable tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成一次结构化的冲刺回顾会议。它会帮你选择回顾格式（如开始/停止/继续、4Ls、帆船法），分析团队反馈和冲刺数据，生成带负责人和截止日期的优先改进事项，并输出一份回顾总结。
howto.when: 当你需要运行冲刺回顾、反思一个冲刺、从团队反馈中创建行动项，或学习如何有效进行回顾时触发。

say.text: 我们来做一个冲刺回顾，用开始/停止/继续格式。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成该格式的回顾。

say.text: 这是团队反馈的便签，帮我分组并找出主题。
say.note: Claude 会分析你提供的反馈并归纳主题。

say.text: 生成上个月冲刺的回顾总结和行动项。
say.note: Claude 会输出包含行动项和指标的总结。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through a structured sprint retrospective. It helps choose a format (Start/Stop/Continue, 4Ls, Sailboat), analyzes team feedback and sprint data, generates prioritized action items with owners and deadlines, and outputs a retro summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to run a sprint retrospective, reflect on a sprint, create action items from team feedback, or learn how to run effective retros.

say_en.text: Let's do a sprint retro using Start/Stop/Continue format.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through that format.

say_en.text: Here are sticky notes from the team. Group them into themes.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and categorize the feedback.

say_en.text: Generate a retro summary and action items for last sprint.
say_en.note: Claude will output a summary with action items.
